pos2obj.mod.description: Select a region with /pos start and /pos end, then export it to OBJ + MTL + textures. Supports modded blocks, block entities, entities, and optional greedy-mesh UV baking for polygon reduction.
pos2obj.msg.hint: [pos2obj] Export with /pos export <name> [options…] (press Tab for options)
pos2obj.msg.weld_summary: [pos2obj] Optimize: %s → %s faces (removed %s degenerate, %s duplicate; weld grid 1/%s block)
pos2obj.error.no_selection: [pos2obj] Set the region first with /pos start and /pos end
pos2obj.opt.desc.atlas: Pack every texture into a single image (default)
pos2obj.opt.desc.bake: Merge faces and bake textures into new UVs (large polygon reduction)
pos2obj.opt.desc.weld: Weld vertices and remove degenerate/duplicate faces
pos2obj.opt.desc.cull: Aggressively cull faces hidden behind opaque neighbors
pos2obj.opt.desc.uv: Bake resolution: %s px per block face
pos2obj.opt.desc.uv_default: Bake resolution: %s px per block face (default)
